crossRefs.note: So he did for all his foreign wives, who burned incense and sacrificed to their gods.
God’s sons saw that men’s daughters were beautiful, and they took any that they wanted for themselves as wives.
He shall not multiply wives to himself, that his heart not turn away. He shall not greatly multiply to himself silver…
In those days I also saw the Jews who had married women of Ashdod, of Ammon, and of Moab;
to deliver you from the strange woman, even from the foreigner who flatters with her words,
Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
to keep you from the immoral woman, from the flattery of the wayward wife’s tongue.
that they may keep you from the strange woman, from the foreigner who flatters with her words.
The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
Solomon made an alliance with Pharaoh king of Egypt, and took Pharaoh’s daughter, and brought her into David’s city…

people.name: Ammon
people.line: An ancient nation and its capital city, enemies of Israel.

people.name: Edom
people.line: Descendants of Esau; enemy nation southeast of Israel

people.name: Heth
people.line: Son of Canaan and ancestor of the Hittites.

people.name: Moab
people.line: Ancient kingdom east of the Dead Sea in Jordan

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: Now king Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites;
translations.bsb: King Solomon, however, loved many foreign women along with the daughter of Pharaoh—women of Moab, Ammon, Edom, and Sidon, as well as Hittite women.
translations.kjv: But king Solomon loved many strange women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Zidonians, and Hittites;
translations.asv: Now king Solomon loved many foreign women, together with the daughter of Pharaoh, women of the Moabites, Ammonites, Edomites, Sidonians, and Hittites;
